PINTAR production origin — forensic request

Editing this file runs the read-only origin diagnosis. It deploys nothing,
writes no environment value and touches no Supabase configuration.

attempt:  001
question: CI probed https://pintar40-yazidmanan-2409.vercel.app/masuk twice at
          ~00:57 UTC and recorded 200 both times. A browser opening the same
          URL receives Vercel's platform 404 NOT_FOUND, edge sin1, body id
          sin1::q6zdw-1790125293981-1b5bb2a0e384.

          Vercel's platform NOT_FOUND means the hostname resolves to no
          deployment -- a deployed Next.js app serving an unknown route would
          render its own 404 instead. So either the alias never propagated
          beyond the edge CI reached, or it has since stopped pointing at a
          deployment.

          The CI probe is also not trustworthy as written: it followed
          redirects and read only the final status code, never asserting the
          body was the sign-in screen. This run records the unfollowed
          response, every redirect hop, the final effective URL, Vercel's
          error and edge headers, the body itself, and what Vercel reports
          about the project's production target, domains and deployments.

nothing is configured or activated until this is reconciled.
